source_snapshot.procedure: Verify all BMC output ports (VGA, DP, USB, Serial) work.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies the required physical connection and observation boundary, but describes only a generic operator report and does not define a complete connector inventory, known-good fixtures or per-port evidence.

original_test_intent.purpose: Physically verify the functional behavior of every platform-defined BMC VGA, DisplayPort, USB and serial connector with a compatible known-good fixture and record an individual result for each connector.
original_test_intent.target: Every physical BMC-associated VGA, DP, USB and serial connector on the exact server configuration, as identified by the product port map; not merely one representative connector of each type.
original_test_intent.scope: One controlled functional observation per required connector during the source's 60-minute attended and 60-minute machine-time estimate, including baseline and restoration. Remote reachability or a single serial console does not cover the display and USB connectors.
original_test_intent.operation: Identify each connector and its owner-defined direction/function, baseline the BMC and active management paths, connect the corresponding known-good fixture under qualified operator control, perform the port-specific observable function, capture evidence, remove the fixture safely and confirm BMC/management health.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source provides 60 attended and 60 machine minutes but no connector count or repetition requirement. Test each required physical connector once unless the platform specification requires additional modes or repetitions.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required connector demonstrates its owner-defined physical and functional behavior with no BMC reset, overcurrent, unexpected enumeration, console disruption or unresolved post-test fault.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Exact server/BMC/firmware identity and connector map; fixture/cable identity and known-good proof; before/after BMC health; per-connector photo or capture, timestamps, applied action, observed display/USB/serial result and discrepancy; restoration record; complete connector reconciliation.
ambiguities: The number, labels, ownership and direction/function of each VGA, DP, USB and serial connector are absent.
Port-specific signal mode, display format, USB device/function and serial electrical/baud/framing/flow-control criteria are absent.
The source does not state whether hot-plug is supported or which active management connection may be disturbed.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly classifies the case as MANUAL ONLY, preserves all four connector families, separates a supplemental remote serial check from physical proof, requires known-good fixtures and per-port evidence, and adds appropriate stop and restoration controls.

applicable_history.decision: V2 correctly maps DeepSeek NO to MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED because a qualified operator can perform the physical observations. No later user ruling changes the connector scope or supplies product-specific pass criteria.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2. The defining evidence is physical, connector-specific observation by a qualified operator. Agent-collected BMC logs and serial reachability are supplemental and cannot replace the VGA, DP, USB or serial fixture results.

available_now: The four required connector families and the requirement that all ports work are explicit.
Read-only BMC identity, firmware, health, SEL and current management-path evidence can be collected before physical connection.
missing_inputs: The hardware/BMC owner must supply the exact connector inventory, labels, ownership/direction and port-specific functional acceptance rules.
The lab owner must supply compatible known-good displays/analyzers, USB fixtures, serial adapter/terminal, cables, physical-access and hot-plug sequence, plus maintenance approval and recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The hardware/BMC owner supplies the connector map and functional rules; the lab operator supplies certified fixtures, physical execution and observations; the system owner authorizes any management-path interruption.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record server, board, BMC and firmware identity, current BMC health/SEL and active management paths without clearing logs.
Inventory labeled connectors from approved product documentation and record candidate fixtures without inserting or removing hardware.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not connect unknown/unsupported devices, assume connector direction or electrical settings, unplug an active management path, force insertion, short pins, clear logs, substitute SSH/remote serial reachability for physical proof, or declare PASS with an untested connector.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Reconcile the owner port map to every physical connector, verify fixture compatibility/known-good status and safe sequence, obtain approval, capture one traceable result per connector and confirm removal/restoration plus healthy BMC and management paths.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC VGA, DisplayPort, USB and Serial Physical Port Function
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every platform-defined BMC VGA, DP, USB and serial connector through its specified physical function using approved known-good fixtures.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board and BMC/firmware revision with the owner-approved connector map, electrical/protocol settings, compatible fixtures and qualified physical operator.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every individual BMC-associated VGA, DP, USB and serial connector in the product map, tested once or according to the platform-required modes. Include BMC and management-path health; do not substitute a representative connector.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Server/BMC identity; connector labels, count, ownership/direction and pass criteria; display/analyzer modes; known-good USB device and expected function; serial adapter and electrical/baud/framing/flow-control settings; fixtures/cables; hot-plug sequence; maintenance approval; active-path and recovery plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Baseline BMC health, logs and management connections. A qualified operator identifies one mapped connector, verifies the correct known-good fixture and approved connection sequence, connects it, performs the owner-defined observable function and captures per-connector evidence. Remove or restore it safely, confirm health, then repeat independently for every required connector.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct chassis/board/BMC/firmware and complete port map verified; fixtures compatible and independently known-good; electrical/protocol settings supplied; physical access and ESD/grounding controls ready; active connections protected; maintenance/recovery approval recorded; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version and port map; fixture/cable identity and known-good check; per-connector label/photo, start/end time, connection sequence, expected function and observed display/link, USB or serial evidence; BMC/SEL/health before and after; anomaly/recovery record; completeness table for every connector.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved connector specification and port-specific functional criteria for the exact platform, constrained by source criteria `All ports work`.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Qualified physical operator only. Use approved fixtures and one controlled connector at a time. Do not assume signal direction/settings, connect unknown USB hardware, force or short a connector, disturb an active management path without approval, clear evidence or claim remote-only observation as physical proof.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Approval is required for physical access, fixture insertion/removal, any active-console or management-path interruption and recovery action. The hardware/BMC owner must approve the port map and pass rules.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator performs and observes every physical connection and records results. An agent may prepare the checklist, collect BMC/host logs and organize evidence, but cannot independently prove connector function without trusted operator or instrument observations.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On a connector, overcurrent, reset, enumeration, display or console anomaly, stop that port, preserve observations/logs, remove the fixture using the approved sequence, restore the previous management path and obtain owner disposition before retest.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong or ambiguous connector; missing/incompatible fixture or settings; unsafe mechanical/electrical condition; unexpected device or overcurrent; BMC reset or health degradation; active management/console disruption; missing evidence; failed restoration; or any unapproved hot-plug or state change.

identified_defects: DeepSeek lacks a complete connector-by-connector evidence and fixture contract.
The source does not provide exact connector inventory or port-specific acceptance rules.
Remote serial-console reachability cannot prove physical VGA, DP, USB and serial connector function.
reason_for_change: No V2 semantic correction is needed; V3 expresses readiness ownership and preserves the physical evidence boundary without turning the case into BLOCKED or an SSH-only check.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00062-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source explicitly requires all BMC VGA, DP, USB and serial ports to work and budgets 60 attended plus 60 machine minutes.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The product connector map and port-specific pass criteria are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Defines `all ports` as every connector in the product map, not one sample per connector family.
Separates supplemental remote evidence from required physical observation.
Requires owner-defined connector direction and function instead of assuming identical semantics across display, USB and serial ports.
resolved_blockers: The need for a human physical operation supports MANUAL ONLY and does not make the understood test semantically BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits the product port map, port-specific criteria, compatible fixtures, safe physical sequence, qualified operator and approval.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V2 is technically sound. V3 preserves it and makes the every-connector completeness rule, direction/function handoff and physical-versus-remote evidence boundary explicit without expanding the test.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Not selected for immediate isolated validation because V2 is retained, risk is medium and no material automation or safety reclassification is proposed.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 2175 requires physical function of all BMC VGA, DP, USB and serial ports, with 60 attended and 60 machine minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly keeps the test MANUAL ONLY and refuses to treat serial or SSH reachability as proof for the other physical ports.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Permit non-invasive inventory/log preparation; require a qualified operator, known-good fixtures, exact port map and approval for every physical connection.
